To throw away victory like that...!!

No matter how many times I taste defeat
and fall to my knees—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to reclaim the throne of the strongest.

text_block_list.text: Naturally. Only the weak come to a halt.

This time, I will fulfill it without fail.
